name.ja: 新規キャラのレベル60の計測

description.en: A freshly created character starts at experience_level 60 with 0 experience_point. Records the whole start-of-game path - what the creation screen hands over, what Character.__init__ receives, which scripts.functions helper returns 60, and who called it - to find where the level is set
description.ja: 新規作成したキャラクタが経験値0のままレベル60で始まる。作成画面が何を渡すか、`Character.__init__` が何を受け取るか、`scripts.functions` のどの関数が 60 を返すか、それを誰が呼んだかを記録して、レベルが決まる場所を特定する
